text: The system of modal logic widely accepted as the correct logic of metaphysical modality, in which whatever is possible is necessarily possible, is called ___.
explanation: S5 adds the characteristic axiom that possibility is non-contingent (possibly-P entails necessarily-possibly-P), and is standardly taken to govern metaphysical necessity by Kripke, Plantinga, and Lewis alike. The weaker system S4 secures only that the necessary is necessarily necessary; the distinctively S5 axiom is the more contested addition.
